parameter.value: GDOT:WBX61 I-285 NB/SB Closed from exits 2 to 5. CALL 511 or go to https://www.gaalert.com

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value:
GDOT: All lanes on I-285 northbound and southbound are closed between SR 6 Camp Creek Pkwy (exit 2) and SR 166 (exit 5) in the city of Atlanta, until 5 a.m. on Monday, November 9th. All I-285 west traffic approaching the closure will use exit 61 for I-85 NB to exit 77 SR 166 WB


. CALL 511 or go to https://www.gaalert.com

info.description: Motorists who use this segment of I-285 should make plans to allow significant additional travel time during the closures, or to plan alternate routes. GDOT strongly urges motorists to rely on the 511GA app or call 511 as the primary source for real-time traffic conditions and lane closure details. Drivers should exercise caution in and around work zones, follow signage guidance, reduce speed, and avoid distractions behind the wheel.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 6 at 10:25PM MST until November 7 at 1:15AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 1:15 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 1:15 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 115 AM MST.

* At 1025 PM MST, The Flash Flood Warning for West Clear Creek has
been extended until 115 PM MST. Heavy rain in the upper West Clear
Creek drainage earlier Friday afternoon is likely still causing
high flows. Flash flooding is likely ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Verde Lakes, Hanging Garden, Indian Maiden Falls and West Clear

info.instruction:
WATER EMERGENCY NOTICE
TOWN OF MANCOS

Friday, November 6, 2026

At approximately 12:20 p.m., the Town of Mancos water treatment facility was unable to keep up with demand. Recent flooding affected the quality of raw water entering the settling ponds. Town of Mancos Public Works is working to repair the system.
The water entering homes and businesses is non-potable and should not be used for drinking or other purposes. It may only be used to flush toilets. This affects customers of the Town of Mancos. Mancos Rural Water customers and people using well water are not affected.
Potable water distribution
Potable water is available at Mancos Brewery, 484 Hwy 160 Frontage Road, Mancos, CO. The distribution center is open 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. Please limit refills to five gallons per person per day and conserve water as much as possible.
Important precautions
- Turn off household ice-making machines until further notice.
- Public restrooms within Town of Mancos limits are recommended to provide hand sanitizer. Hand-washing followed by sanitizer is encouraged.
- Restaurants within Town of Mancos limits with operational questions should contact the Montezuma County Health Department.
For updates, check www.mancoscolorado.com and the Town of Mancos Facebook page.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 6 at 5:22PM MST until November 6 at 11:15PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 11:15 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 11:15 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 1115 PM MST.

* At 522 PM MST, National Weather Service Flagstaff Doppler radar
indicated heavy rainfall in the West Clear Creek drainage from
earlier thunderstorms. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to
begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Verde Lakes, Hanging Garden, Indian Maiden Falls and West Clear
Creek Wilderness.

This includes State Route 260 between mile markers 225 and 229.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Clear Creek Group Campgrounds.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Bull Pen Day Use Area, West Clear Creek near the campground and
Indian Maiden Falls.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Verde River near the confluence of West Clear Creek and West Clear
Creek.
info.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 3:00 PM EST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southeastern Wayne County in central North Carolina...

* Until 300 PM EST.

* At 229 PM EST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 7 miles southwest of Goldsboro, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Goldsboro and Walnut Creek around 235 PM EST.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include
Mar-Mac, Elroy, Brogden, and Cliffs Of The Neuse State Park.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued November 6 at 1:53PM EST until November 6 at 2:30PM EST by NWS Raleigh NC

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 2:30 PM EST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 2:30 PM EST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southwestern Wayne County in central North Carolina...
Northeastern Sampson County in central North Carolina...

* Until 230 PM EST.

* At 153 PM EST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 13 miles southeast of Benson, or 16 miles west of Mount
Olive, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Mount Olive and Mount Olive around 210 PM EST.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include
Mar-Mac, Grantham, Brogden, and Newton Grove.

This includes Interstate 40 between Mile Markers 340 and 345.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

info.description:
TORRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southeastern Sampson County in central North Carolina...

* Until 200 PM EST.

* At 119 PM EST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Lagoon, or 14 miles east of Elizabethtown, moving
northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Harrells around 130 PM EST.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include
Ivanhoe.
info.instruction:
This Tornado Warning replaces the Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued
for the same area.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued November 6 at 1:00PM EST until November 6 at 1:30PM EST by NWS Wilmington NC

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 1:30 PM EST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 1:30 PM EST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORILM

The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
East Central Bladen County in southeastern North Carolina...

* Until 130 PM EST.

* At 100 PM EST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Lisbon, or 7 miles southeast of Elizabethtown,
moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* This tornado will be near...
Lisbon around 105 PM EST.
Lagoon around 110 PM EST.

Other locations impacted by the tornado include White Lake.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Please send your reports of hail or wind damage by calling the
National Weather Service office in Wilmington at 1 800 697 3901.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY this area til 11:00 AM EST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY is in effect for this area until 11:00 AM EST. This is an extremely dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
North Central Fannin County in north central Georgia...

* Until 1100 AM EST.

* At 857 AM EST, emergency management reported significant flooding
in and around McCaysville. No additional rainfall is expected, but
flooding impacts will continue.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for McCaysville. This is a PARTICULARLY
DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
McCaysville and nearby areas of North Central Fannin County.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Hothouse Creek, Toccoa River, Ocoee River and Fightingtown Creek.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 5 at 8:57AM EST until November 5 at 11:00AM EST by NWS Morristown TN

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY this area til 11:00 AM EST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY is in effect for this area until 11:00 AM EST. This is an extremely dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWMRX

The National Weather Service in Morristown has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Polk County in east Tennessee...

* Until 1100 AM EST.

* At 857 AM EST, Local law enforcement reported widespread
catastrophic flash flooding was still ongoing with numerous
businesses and homes under several feet of water.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Copperhill. This is a PARTICULARLY
DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ducktown and Copperhill.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

info.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
North Central Fannin County in north central Georgia...

* Until 900 AM EST.

* At 639 AM EST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain in McCaysville. Between 3 and 5
inches of rain have fallen. Flooding impacts will continue, but no
additional rainfall is expected. Flash flooding is already
occurring.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for McCaysville. This is a PARTICULARLY
DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of North Central Fannin County.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 5 at 6:23AM EST until November 5 at 9:00AM EST by NWS Morristown TN

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY this area til 9:00 AM EST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY is in effect for this area until 9:00 AM EST. This is an extremely dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWMRX

The National Weather Service in Morristown has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Polk County in east Tennessee...

* Until 900 AM EST.

* At 623 AM EST, Local law enforcement reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain in Copperhill. Widespread catastrophic flash
flooding is ongoing with numerous businesses and homes under
several feet of water.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Copperhill. This is a PARTICULARLY
DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses. Please heed all local
evacuation orders.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ducktown and Copperhill.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

info.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
North Central Fannin County in north central Georgia...

* Until 815 AM EST.

* At 508 AM EST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain in McCaysville. Between 3 and 5
inches of rain have fallen. Flooding impacts will continue, but no
additional rainfall is expected. Flash flooding is already
occurring.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for McCaysville. This is a PARTICULARLY
DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of North Central Fannin County.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

thunderstorms producing heavy rain in McCaysville. Between 3 and 5
inches of rain have fallen. Flooding impacts will continue, but no
additional rainfall is expected. Flash flooding is already
occurring.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for McCaysville. This is a PARTICULARLY
DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of North Central Fannin County.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

info.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Fannin County in north central Georgia...
Gilmer County in north central Georgia...
Northwestern Union County in north central Georgia...
Murray County in northwestern Georgia...

* Until 700 AM EST.

* At 448 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain across the warned
area. Between 3 and 6 inches of rain have fallen. Flooding impacts
will continue, but no additional rainfall is expected. Flash
flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Chatsworth, Ellijay, Blue Ridge, Eton, East Ellijay, Morganton,
Colwell, Cherry Log, Higdon, Mountaintown, Jones Mill, Epworth,
Conasauga Lake, Tails Creek, Cohutta Wilderness, Talona, Mineral
Bluff, Roundtop, Fort Mountain State Park and Loving.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 5 at 4:22AM EST until November 5 at 7:15AM EST by NWS Morristown TN

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 7:15 AM EST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 7:15 AM EST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWMRX

The National Weather Service in Morristown has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Cherokee County in southwestern North Carolina...
Southeastern Polk County in east Tennessee...

* Until 715 AM EST.

* At 422 AM EST, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches
of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ducktown, Copperhill, William L. Davenport Refuge, Hot House, Big
Frog Mountain and Culberson.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY is in effect for this area until 7:00 AM EST. This is an extremely dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWMRX

The National Weather Service in Morristown has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Polk County in east Tennessee...

* Until 700 AM EST.

* At 358 AM EST, Widespread significant flooding is ongoing with
homes and business under water and being evacuated due to runoff
along the Ocoee from extreme heavy rainfall in Georgia. Flash
flooding is ongoing.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Copperhill. This is a PARTICULARLY
DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported widespread significant flash
flooding and numerous homes and business under water. The
Ocoee River has risen to Major Flood Stage and is 3 feet
from its all-time peak.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ducktown and Copperhill.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

parameter.name: CMAMtext

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 5:00 AM EST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Fannin County in north central Georgia...
Gilmer County in north central Georgia...
Northwestern Union County in north central Georgia...
Murray County in northwestern Georgia...

* Until 500 AM EST.

* At 234 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amount up to 1 inch are possible
in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Chatsworth, Ellijay, Blue Ridge, Eton, East Ellijay, Morganton,
Colwell, Cherry Log, Higdon, Mountaintown, Jones Mill, Epworth,
Conasauga Lake, Tails Creek, Cohutta Wilderness, Talona, Mineral
Bluff, Roundtop, Fort Mountain State Park and Loving.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

The National Weather Service in Morristown has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Cherokee County in southwestern North Carolina...
Southeastern Polk County in east Tennessee...

* Until 515 AM EST.

* At 219 AM EST, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches
of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported multiple roads closed and water
going into homes in the Grassy Creek area.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses due to
recent heavy rainfall and runoff from places to the south.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ducktown, Hot House, Copperhill, Culberson, William L. Davenport
Refuge and Big Frog Mountain.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Northwestern Fannin County in north central Georgia...

producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 5 and 6 inches
of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 2.5

possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing.

rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 5 inches of rain have
fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

flash flooding.

areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Conasauga Lake, Tails Creek, Cohutta Wilderness, Talona, Mineral
Bluff, Roundtop, Fort Mountain State Park and Loving.
info.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

parameter.name: NWSheadline
parameter.value: FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY FOR SOUTHERN FANNIN AND NORTHERN GILMER

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY this area til 1:30 AM EST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY is in effect for this area until 1:30 AM EST. This is an extremely dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Fannin County in north central Georgia...
North Central Gilmer County in north central Georgia...

* Until 130 AM EST.

* At 1047 PM EST, Local law enforcement reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area resulting in mudslides
and water rescue. Between 5 and 6 inches of rain have fallen.
Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible in the
warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Southern Fannin and Northern Gilmer. This
is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Blue Ridge, Higdon and Colwell.
info.instruction:
Move to higher ground now! This is an extremely dangerous and
life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are
fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 4 at 9:30PM EST until November 5 at 12:30AM EST by NWS Peachtree City GA

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 12:30 AM EST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 12:30 AM EST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Fannin County in north central Georgia...
North Central Gilmer County in north central Georgia...

* Until 1230 AM EST.

* At 930 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 2.5 inches in 1
hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Blue Ridge, Higdon and Colwell.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 4:00 PM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 4:00 PM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORBMX

The National Weather Service in Birmingham has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
East central Bibb County in central Alabama...

* Until 400 PM CST.

* At 325 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Ashby, or 10 miles east of Centreville, moving
northeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Brierfield Ironworks Park and Ashby.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

Por favor, utilice una ruta alternativa y de suficiente espacio al personal de emergencia para que pueda trabajar de manera segura. Proporcionaremos informacion adicional cuando sea apropiado.

parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 6:00 PM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORJAN

The National Weather Service in Jackson has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Ashley County in southeastern Arkansas...

* Until 600 PM CST.

* At 459 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near West Crossett, or near Huttig, moving northeast at
35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Crossett, North Crossett, and West Crossett around 505 PM CST.
Hamburg around 515 PM CST.
Old Milo around 520 PM CST.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include
Blanchton.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued November 3 at 4:40PM CST until November 3 at 5:15PM CST by NWS Shreveport LA

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 5:15 PM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 5:15 PM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORSHV

The National Weather Service in Shreveport has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southeastern Union County in south central Arkansas...
Northeastern Union Parish in north central Louisiana...

* Until 515 PM CST.

* At 440 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 5 miles southwest of Huttig, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Huttig, Felsenthal, Litroe and Cecil.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Heavy rainfall is hiding this tornado. Do not wait to see or hear the
tornado. Take cover now!

info.description:
TORLCH

The National Weather Service in Lake Charles has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
East central Vernon Parish in west central Louisiana...

* Until 445 PM CST.

* At 413 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located over Fullerton, or 7 miles northwest of Pitkin, moving
northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This tornadic thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
east central Vernon Parish.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile
home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and
protect yourself from flying debris.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 3 at 2:51PM MST until November 3 at 9:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 9:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 9:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Havasu Creek basin in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 900 PM MST Tuesday.

* At 251 PM MST, A river gauge on Cataract Creek below Heather Wash
reported a rapid rise of 2.7 feet. This rise is due to runoff from
heavy rain that occurred on previous days. Flash flooding is
already occurring.

HAZARD...Runoff from the most recent storm is producing flash
flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of areas in and around the Havasu Creek
basin.

* For Cataract Creek at Cataract Creek Below Heather Wash:
At 1:30pm the stage was 6.4 feet.
Flood Stage is 7.5 feet.
Impacts:
At 7.5 feet: 450 cfs flow. May cause minor flooding downstream in
Supai campground 4 to 7 hours later.
At 10.0 feet: 1520 cfs flow. May cause moderate flooding downstream
in Suapi villago 4 to 7 hours later.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Supai, Havasupai Reservation, Little Navajo Falls, Mooney Falls and
Beaver Falls.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 157 and 158.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River, Havasu Creek, Sinyella Canyon and Little Coyote
Canyon.
info.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Foot bridges will be washed out in Supai Campground. Some campsites
will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions of the
campground.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued November 3 at 3:01PM CST until November 3 at 3:45PM CST by NWS Shreveport LA

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 3:45 PM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 3:45 PM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORSHV

The National Weather Service in Shreveport has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Northwestern Lincoln Parish in north central Louisiana...
West Central Union Parish in north central Louisiana...
East Central Claiborne Parish in northwestern Louisiana...

* Until 345 PM CST.

* At 301 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 11 miles southwest of Bernice, or 13 miles east of
Homer, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Bernice and Lisbon.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Heavy rainfall is hiding this tornado. Do not wait to see or hear the
tornado. Take cover now!

Central Bossier Parish in northwestern Louisiana... South Central Caddo Parish in northwestern Louisiana... * Until 1245 PM CST. * At 1158 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado was located over Shreveport, moving northeast at 30 mph. HAZARD...Tornado. SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation. IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is likely. * Locations impacted include... Shreveport, Bossier City, Benton, Fosters, Eastwood, Ferguson, Red Chute, Linton, Barksdale Air Force Base, Bodcau, Princeton, Bellevue, Fillmore and Alden Bridge. Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Heavy rainfall is hiding this tornado. Do not wait to see or hear the tornado. Take cover now! Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to flash flooding. Northwestern De Soto Parish in northwestern Louisiana...
East Central Panola County in northeastern Texas...

northeast at 30 mph.

shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

Shreveport, Stonewall, Keachi, Keithville and Spring Ridge.

flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 11:45 AM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 11:45 AM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORSHV

The National Weather Service in Shreveport has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
South Central Lafayette County in southwestern Arkansas...
Northwestern Bossier Parish in northwestern Louisiana...

* Until 1145 AM CST.

* At 1055 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a
tornado was located near Plain Dealing, or 18 miles southwest of
Springhill, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Plain Dealing, Bradley, Bolinger and State Line.
info.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: Servicio Nacional de Meteorologia: AVISO DE TORNADO en efecto hasta las 11:45 AM CST. Busque refugio ahora en un sotano o en el interior de un cuarto en el nivel mas bajo de un edificio seguro. Si esta al aire libre, en una casa movil, o en un vehiculo, debe ir al edificio seguro mas cercano y protegerse de proyectiles. Consulte los medios informativos.

info.description:
TORSGF

The National Weather Service in Springfield has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southeastern Christian County in southwestern Missouri...

* Until 845 AM CST.

* At 829 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 9 miles south of Sparta, or 10 miles southeast of
Highlandville, moving northeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Sparta, Oldfield, Keltner, and Chadwick.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

Si esta al aire libre, en una casa movil, o en un vehiculo, debe ir al edificio seguro mas cercano y protegerse de proyectiles. Consulte los medios informativos.

info.description:
TORSGF

The National Weather Service in Springfield has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southeastern Christian County in southwestern Missouri...

* Until 845 AM CST.

* At 829 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 9 miles south of Sparta, or 10 miles southeast of
Highlandville, moving northeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Sparta, Oldfield, Keltner, and Chadwick.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 3 at 2:05AM MST until November 3 at 9:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 9:00 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 9:00 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Havasu Creek basin in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 900 AM MST Tuesday.

* At 205 AM MST, a river gauge on Cataract Creek reported a rapid
rise of 5.38 feet as a result of heavy rain far upstream. A flood
wave is traveling through Cataract/Havasu Creek. Estimated time for
impacts to begin at Supai is between 9 AM to noon MST, though this
may change. Stay tuned to future updates for refinements on this
estimate.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain producing
flash flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Havasu Creek basin.

* For Cataract Creek at Cataract Creek Below Heather Wash:
At 1:30am the stage was 4.46 feet.
Flood Stage is 7.5 feet.
Impacts:
At 7.5 feet: 450 cfs flow. May cause minor flooding downstream in
Supai campground 4 to 7 hours later.
At 10.0 feet: 1520 cfs flow. May cause moderate flooding downstream
in Suapi village 4 to 7 hours later.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Supai, Havasupai Reservation, Little Navajo Falls, Mooney Falls and
Beaver Falls.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Very Last Chance Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Heather Wash, Sinyella Canyon, Little Coyote Canyon, Pasture Wash,
Havasu Creek, Black Tank Wash, Colorado River and Coconino Wash.
info.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Foot bridges will be washed out in Supai Campground. Some campsites
will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions of the
campground.

parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 3:15 AM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 3:15 AM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORTSA

The National Weather Service in Tulsa has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southwestern Washington County in northwestern Arkansas...
Southeastern Adair County in northeastern Oklahoma...

* Until 315 AM CST.

* At 223 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 6 miles southeast of Stilwell, moving northeast at 25
mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations in or near the path include...
Stilwell...                       Lincoln...
Westville...                      Adair State Park...
Strickler...                      Baron...
Maryetta...                       Clyde...
Canehill...                       Odell...
Summers...                        Morrow...
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 3:00 AM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 3:00 AM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORTSA

The National Weather Service in Tulsa has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Northern Crawford County in northwestern Arkansas...
South central Washington County in northwestern Arkansas...

* Until 300 AM CST.

* At 209 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 3 miles west of Figure Five, moving northeast at 45
mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations in or near the path include...
Van Buren...                      Cedarville...
Mountainburg...                   Natural Dam...
Chester...                        Rudy...
Devils Den State Park...          Lake Fort Smith...
Strickler...                      Figure Five...
Lee Creek...                      Blackburn...
Uniontown...                      Locke...

This includes Interstate 49 between mile markers 24 and 43.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued November 3 at 1:11AM CST until November 3 at 2:00AM CST by NWS Tulsa OK

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 2:00 AM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 2:00 AM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TORTSA

The National Weather Service in Tulsa has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southeastern Craig County in northeastern Oklahoma...
Southwestern Ottawa County in northeastern Oklahoma...
Northwestern Mayes County in northeastern Oklahoma...

* Until 200 AM CST.

* At 111 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Adair, moving northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations in or near the path include...
Vinita...                         Afton...
Adair...                          Big Cabin...
Pensacola...                      White Oak...
Strang...                         Pyramid Corners...

This includes Interstate 44 between mile markers 267 and 298.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

info.headline: Tornado Warning issued November 2 at 5:31PM CST until November 2 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Norman OK

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: TORNADO WARNING in this area til 6:00 PM CST. Take shelter now. Check media.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: TORNADO WARNING in this area until 6:00 PM CST. Take shelter now in a basement or an interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris. Check media.

info.description:
TOROUN

The National Weather Service in Norman has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Southwestern Cotton County in southwestern Oklahoma...
Southeastern Tillman County in southwestern Oklahoma...
Central Wichita County in northern Texas...

* Until 600 PM CST.

* At 530 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 7 miles east of Electra, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* Locations impacted include...
Burkburnett, Randlett, and Cashion.

This includes Interstate 44 between mile markers 0 and 8.
info.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a storm shelter, safe room or an interior
room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you
are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest
substantial shelter and protect yourself from flying debris.

info.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 2 at 1:23PM MST until November 2 at 8:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ

parameter.name: CMAMtext
parameter.value: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:00 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.

parameter.name: CMAMlongtext
parameter.value: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:00 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

info.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* Until 800 PM MST Monday.

* At 123 PM MST, the river gauge on the Little Colorado River at
Winslow has risen above Major flood stage. Additional rises are
forecast through late tonight, with flooding impacts to Ames Acres
and Bushman Acres in Winslow. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of the Little Colorado
River.

* For Little Colorado at Winslow:
At 1:00pm MST the stage was 25.1 feet.
Flood Stage is 19.0 feet.
Forecast: A crest of 40.15 feet is expected at 3:00am MST Tuesday.
Impacts:
At 25.0 feet: Levee is overtopped. Major flooding of portions of
Winslow including Ames Acres and Bushman Acres.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Winslow, Leupp, Birdsprings, Sunrise, Bushman Acres and Homolovi
Ruins State Park.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between mile markers 254 and 258. Business Interstate
40 between mile markers 256 and 257. State Route 87 between mile
markers 346 and 347.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Homolovi State Park Campground.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Colorado River.
info.instruction:
Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.
